author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
This week I am in Southern Yunnan near the China-Myanmar Border, and there is something very special in this region. Not only is this a county of the Dai People (Chinese Thai Ethnic Group) but also it's the only place in China where you can find a real tropical rainforest. And within this forest, there is a market with very exquisite delicacies. 
Join me on this adventure through China's border regions 🎬
